newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portucel shares rise, more seen, on restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Portucel shares rise, more seen, on restructuring.

text.p: Pulp group Portucel Industrial-Empresa Produtora de Celulose rose over four percent, with traders seeing room for more gains, on reports a decision on the local industry's restructuring is near.
The stock was also being boosted by the industrial outlook for 1997, with a progressive decline in pulp stocks and a rise in international prices, traders said.
"The tendency is for Portucel to gain but not to hit its record highs, not for the moment," said one trader.
The stock was trading at 1,464 escudos, up 4.2 percent from Tuesday. The record high is 1,524.
